en: Panchala as an ancient kingdom of northern India in the Ganges plain
Its division into northern and southern parts and its role in the epic tradition
zh: 般遮罗是北印度恒河平原的古代王国
分为南北两部，在史诗传统中地位重要

politics.zh: 般遮罗是北印度恒河平原的古代王国，位于今北方邦中部与西部，约公元前1千纪前期见于吠陀文献，分北般遮罗与南般遮罗两部，分别以阿希查特拉与坎皮利亚为中心。它由部落首领与后来形成的王统治理，与俱卢、苏罗娑及摩揭陀互动，在吠陀祭祀与早期国家竞争中作用重要；后期被摩揭陀等强国纳入影响范围。
politics.en: Panchala was an ancient kingdom of northern India in the Ganges plain, in what is now central and western Uttar Pradesh, recorded in Vedic texts from the earlier first millennium BC and divided into northern and southern parts centred on Ahichchhatra and Kampilya. Governed by tribal chiefs and later by a royal line, it interacted with the Kurus, Surasenas and Magadha and played an important part in Vedic sacrifice and early state competition; later it came within the sphere of stronger states such as Magadha.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河平原的农业、畜牧与祭祀经济为基础，牛群与谷物是主要财富，村落与祭祀场所构成社会组织核心，河流与陆路商道提供交换条件，铁器与陶器使用见于考古。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding in the Ganges plain and on the economy of sacrifice, with cattle and grain the main forms of wealth, villages and sacrificial sites forming the core of social organisation, river and land routes providing the means of exchange, and the use of iron and pottery known from archaeology.

culture.zh: 般遮罗在吠陀文献与史诗传统中均有重要地位，被视为婆罗门学术与祭祀传统的中心之一，彩绘灰陶文化见于考古，王统谱系与口传诗歌保存了其历史记忆。
culture.en: Panchala holds an important place both in Vedic texts and in epic tradition and is regarded as one of the centres of Brahmanical learning and sacrifice, the painted grey ware culture is known from archaeology, and royal genealogies and oral poetry preserve its historical memory.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前1千纪前期王国的形成、南北两部的分立、与俱卢及摩揭陀等国的互动，以及后期被摩揭陀等强国纳入影响范围，这些过程构成北印度早期国家史的一部分。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the earlier first millennium BC, the division into northern and southern parts, its dealings with the Kurus, Magadha and other states and its later absorption into the sphere of stronger powers, processes that form part of the early state history of northern India.

value.zh: 分为北般遮罗与南般遮罗两部。
value.en: It was divided into northern and southern Panchala.

value.zh: 分以阿希查特拉与坎皮利亚为中心。
value.en: Their centres were Ahichchhatra and Kampilya.

en: The Thanjavur Nayak kingdom, established by Sevappa Nayaka around 1532, as a ruling lineage in southern India
Its rule over the Kaveri delta and its patronage of literature and temple building
zh: 坦贾武尔纳亚克王国由塞瓦帕·纳亚卡约1532年建立
统治高韦里河三角洲，赞助文学与寺庙建筑

politics.zh: 坦贾武尔纳亚克王国由塞瓦帕·纳亚卡约1532年建立，是南印度纳亚克诸政权之一，以坦贾武尔为中心，名义上臣属维查耶纳伽尔帝国，帝国衰落后实际独立。它统治高韦里河三角洲，与马杜赖、金吉等纳亚克政权及后来的迈索尔、马拉塔势力互动；1673年后被马拉塔人夺取，纳亚克统治结束。
politics.en: The Thanjavur Nayak kingdom, established by Sevappa Nayaka around 1532, was one of the Nayaka states of southern India, centred on Thanjavur and nominally subject to the Vijayanagara empire, becoming effectively independent as that empire declined. It ruled the Kaveri delta and interacted with the Nayaka states of Madurai and Gingee and later with Mysore and the Marathas; after 1673 it was taken by the Marathas and Nayaka rule came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以高韦里河三角洲的稻作农业、灌溉系统与手工业为基础，三角洲的渠道网络支撑密集耕作，稻米、布匹与寺庙经济是重要财源，港口参与东南沿海贸易。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming in the Kaveri delta, irrigation systems and crafts, with the delta's channel network supporting intensive cultivation, rice, cloth and the temple economy important sources of revenue, and ports taking part in trade along the south-eastern coast.

culture.zh: 纳亚克时期坦贾武尔的寺庙建筑与艺术得到发展，布 Brihadishvara 寺庙的附属建筑与壁画留下遗存，泰卢固语与泰米尔语文学受到赞助，音乐与舞蹈传统延续，宫廷成为南印度文化中心之一。
culture.en: In the Nayaka period temple building and art developed at Thanjavur, subsidiary structures and paintings of the Brihadishvara temple surviving as remains, Telugu and Tamil literature being patronised, music and dance traditions continuing, and the court becoming one of the cultural centres of southern India.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约1532年王国的建立、16世纪对高韦里三角洲的治理与建设、1673年马拉塔人的夺取，以及此后该地区的政治变迁，这些事件决定了坦贾武尔在近代早期的归属。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom around 1532, its government and building works in the Kaveri delta in the sixteenth century, the Maratha seizure of 1673 and the political changes in the region afterwards, events that determined the allegiance of Thanjavur in the early modern period.

value.zh: 约1532年由塞瓦帕·纳亚卡建立。
value.en: It was established by Sevappa Nayaka around 1532.
It was taken by the Marathas after 1673.

en: The Kingdom of Polonnaruwa as a Sinhalese kingdom in Sri Lanka
Its rule from the eleventh to the thirteenth century and its irrigation works and Buddhist monuments
zh: 波隆纳鲁瓦王国是斯里兰卡的僧伽罗王国
11至13世纪统治，以灌溉工程与佛教遗迹著称

politics.zh: 波隆纳鲁瓦王国是斯里兰卡的僧伽罗王国，11世纪在朱罗王朝撤出后由维贾亚巴胡一世建立，以波隆纳鲁瓦为都。它在波罗迦罗摩巴胡一世时期达到鼎盛，统一全岛并远征南印度与缅甸方向；13世纪起受潘地亚与本地势力压力，都城被弃，政治中心南移与西移，王国分裂。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Polonnaruwa was a Sinhalese kingdom in Sri Lanka established in the eleventh century by Vijayabahu I after the withdrawal of the Chola, with Polonnaruwa as its capital. It reached its height under Parakramabahu I, who unified the island and sent expeditions towards southern India and Burma; from the thirteenth century it came under pressure from the Pandyas and local powers, the capital was abandoned and the political centre shifted south and west as the kingdom divided.

economy.zh: 经济以水稻农业、庞大的灌溉系统与对外贸易为基础，波罗迦罗摩海等水库与渠道网络扩大耕地，稻米、宝石与香料是重要物产，与南印度及东南亚的贸易活跃。
economy.en: The economy rested on rice farming, an extensive irrigation system and foreign trade, with reservoirs such as the Parakrama Samudra and channel networks extending cultivation, rice, gems and spices among its important products, and trade with southern India and South-East Asia active.

culture.zh: 波隆纳鲁瓦留下大量佛教建筑与雕刻，佛塔、寺院与石像被列为世界遗产，僧伽罗语文学与巴利文佛学著作在此时期发展，印度教寺庙的存在反映多元宗教影响。
culture.en: Polonnaruwa left a great deal of Buddhist architecture and sculpture, its stupas, monasteries and stone images being World Heritage sites, Sinhalese literature and Pali Buddhist scholarship developing in this period, and the presence of Hindu temples reflecting plural religious influence.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪王国的建立与统一全岛、12世纪波罗迦罗摩巴胡一世的建设与远征、13世纪的入侵与都城废弃，以及此后政治中心的转移，这些事件改变了斯里兰卡的政治地理。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom and the unification of the island in the eleventh century, the building works and expeditions of Parakramabahu I in the twelfth, the invasions and abandonment of the capital in the thirteenth and the later shift of the political centre, events that changed the political geography of Sri Lanka.

value.zh: 佛塔、寺院与石像被列为世界遗产。
value.en: Its stupas, monasteries and stone images are World Heritage sites.

en: The Berar Sultanate as an early modern Indian kingdom in the Deccan ruled by the Imad Shahi dynasty
Its existence from 1490 to 1574 and its absorption by Ahmadnagar
zh: 贝拉尔苏丹国是德干早期近代印度王国，由伊马德沙希王朝统治
1490至1574年存在，后被艾哈迈德讷格尔吞并

politics.zh: 贝拉尔苏丹国是德干早期近代印度王国，由伊马德沙希王朝统治，1490年由法提赫·乌拉·伊马德·沙阿在巴赫曼尼苏丹国瓦解后建立，以埃利奇普尔为中心。它参与德干诸苏丹国的联盟与战争，与艾哈迈德讷格尔、比贾普尔、比德尔及维查耶纳伽尔互动；1574年被艾哈迈德讷格尔吞并，此后其地成为莫卧儿与马拉塔争夺的对象。
politics.en: The Berar Sultanate was an early modern Indian kingdom in the Deccan ruled by the Imad Shahi dynasty, founded in 1490 by Fathullah Imad Shah after the break-up of the Bahmani Sultanate with Ellichpur as its centre. It took part in the alliances and wars of the Deccan sultanates and interacted with Ahmadnagar, Bijapur, Bidar and Vijayanagara; in 1574 it was absorbed by Ahmadnagar, after which its lands became an object of contention between the Mughals and the Marathas.

economy.zh: 经济以德干高原的棉花种植、纺织业与商路贸易为基础，贝拉尔以棉布生产闻名，连接北印度与德干的商道带来关税收入，农业与手工业市镇构成经济基础。
economy.en: The economy rested on cotton growing on the Deccan plateau, textile production and trade along the routes, with Berar known for its cotton cloth, the routes linking northern India with the Deccan bringing customs revenue, and farming and craft towns forming the economic base.

culture.zh: 贝拉尔苏丹国留下伊斯兰建筑与波斯化宫廷文化，清真寺与陵墓见于埃利奇普尔，波斯语与德干地方语言并用，苏菲道堂在社会生活中作用重要，与德干诸国的文化联系密切。
culture.en: The sultanate left Islamic architecture and a Persianate court culture, its mosques and tombs being found at Ellichpur, Persian and local Deccan languages both in use, Sufi lodges important in social life, and its cultural links with the other Deccan states close.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1490年苏丹国的建立、德干诸国的联盟与战争、16世纪中叶的内争，以及1574年被艾哈迈德讷格尔吞并，这些事件构成德干诸国时期的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the sultanate in 1490, the alliances and wars of the Deccan states, the internal conflicts of the mid-sixteenth century and its absorption by Ahmadnagar in 1574, events that make up the history of the Deccan sultanates period.

value.zh: 1490年由法提赫·乌拉·伊马德·沙阿建立。
value.en: It was founded in 1490 by Fathullah Imad Shah.
It was absorbed by Ahmadnagar in 1574.

en: The Gahadavala dynasty, also known as the Gahadavalas of Kannauj, as a Rajput dynasty of northern India
Its rule over the Ganges plain in the eleventh and twelfth centuries and its defeat by the Ghurids
zh: 加哈达瓦拉王朝又称卡瑙杰的加哈达瓦拉，是北印度拉杰普特王朝
11至12世纪统治恒河平原，后被古尔王朝击败

politics.zh: 加哈达瓦拉王朝又称卡瑙杰的加哈达瓦拉，是北印度拉杰普特王朝，11世纪末在波罗王朝与拉施特拉库塔势力衰落后兴起，以卡瑙杰与瓦拉纳西为中心，统治恒河中游平原。它与乔汉、金德拉及伽色尼、古尔等外来势力长期交战；1194年钱德拉德瓦在战斗中败于古尔王朝的穆罕默德，其地随后被并入德里苏丹国。
politics.en: The Gahadavala dynasty, also known as the Gahadavalas of Kannauj, was a Rajput dynasty of northern India that emerged at the end of the eleventh century as Pala and Rashtrakuta power declined, centred on Kannauj and Varanasi and ruling the middle Ganges plain. It fought a long series of wars with the Chauhans, the Chandelas and outside powers such as the Ghaznavids and Ghurids; in 1194 Chandradeva was defeated in battle by Muhammad of Ghor and its lands were afterwards incorporated into the Delhi Sultanate.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河中游平原的农业、手工业与商路贸易为基础，卡瑙杰与瓦拉纳西是商业与宗教中心，谷物、布匹与香料是重要交换物，恒河提供运输之利，寺庙与市镇经济发达。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the middle Ganges plain, crafts and trade along the routes, with Kannauj and Varanasi as centres of commerce and religion, grain, cloth and spices among the goods exchanged, the Ganges providing transport, and temple and town economy well developed.

culture.zh: 加哈达瓦拉时期北印度的印度教寺庙建筑与梵语文学得到赞助，瓦拉纳西作为宗教中心地位突出，铭文记录了土地赠予与王统，雕塑与建筑风格影响后世。
culture.en: In the Gahadavala period Hindu temple architecture and Sanskrit literature in northern India were patronised, Varanasi standing out as a religious centre, inscriptions recording land grants and the royal line, and its sculpture and architectural style influencing later work.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪末王朝的兴起、12世纪与乔汉及金德拉的战争、1194年败于古尔王朝，以及此后其地并入德里苏丹国，这些事件开启了北印度被外来王朝统治的时期。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the dynasty at the end of the eleventh century, its wars with the Chauhans and Chandelas in the twelfth, its defeat by the Ghurids in 1194 and the incorporation of its lands into the Delhi Sultanate, events that opened a period of rule by outside dynasties in northern India.

value.zh: 以卡瑙杰与瓦拉纳西为中心。
value.en: It was centred on Kannauj and Varanasi.

value.zh: 1194年败于古尔王朝后并入德里苏丹国。
value.en: After its defeat by the Ghurids in 1194 its lands were incorporated into the Delhi Sultanate.

en: Kashi as an ancient kingdom of India whose existence is attested during the Iron Age
Its rivalry with Kosala and its absorption into that kingdom
zh: 迦尸是印度古代王国，铁器时代即见于记载
与憍萨罗长期竞争，后被其吞并

politics.zh: 迦尸是印度古代王国，铁器时代即见于记载，位于今北方邦瓦拉纳西一带，以瓦拉纳西（波罗奈）为中心，约公元前1千纪前期见于吠陀与佛教文献。它由本地王统统治，与憍萨罗、摩揭陀及跋阇联盟互动，是十六大国时期的重要势力；后在与憍萨罗的长期竞争中被吞并，其地成为憍萨罗的一部分。
politics.en: Kashi was an ancient kingdom of India attested during the Iron Age, in the area of Varanasi in what is now Uttar Pradesh, centred on Varanasi, or Benares, and recorded in Vedic and Buddhist texts from the earlier first millennium BC. Ruled by a local royal line, it interacted with Kosala, Magadha and the Vajji confederacy and was an important power of the mahajanapada period; after a long rivalry with Kosala it was absorbed into that kingdom.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河中游的农业、手工业与河运贸易为基础，瓦拉纳西是商业与宗教中心，谷物、布匹与香料是重要交换物，恒河渡口与商道带来通行与市场之利。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the middle Ganges region, crafts and river trade, with Varanasi a centre of commerce and religion, grain, cloth and spices among the goods exchanged, and the river crossings and trade routes bringing revenue from passage and markets.

culture.zh: 迦尸以瓦拉纳西的宗教地位闻名，湿婆崇拜与婆罗门学术在此集中，佛教与耆那教文献亦记载其国王与辩论，梵语文学与寺庙传统延续，成为印度宗教地理的核心之一。
culture.en: Kashi is known for the religious standing of Varanasi, where Shiva worship and Brahmanical learning were concentrated, Buddhist and Jain texts also recording its kings and debates, Sanskrit literature and temple tradition continuing, and the region becoming one of the cores of India's religious geography.

events.zh: 关键节点包括铁器时代王国的形成、与憍萨罗及摩揭陀的互动、长期的迦尸-憍萨罗竞争，以及最终被憍萨罗吞并，这些事件构成十六大国时期政治竞争的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the Iron Age, its dealings with Kosala and Magadha, the long Kashi-Kosala rivalry and its eventual absorption into Kosala, events that make up the history of political competition in the mahajanapada period.

value.zh: 以瓦拉纳西（波罗奈）为中心。
value.en: It was centred on Varanasi, or Benares.

value.zh: 与憍萨罗长期竞争，最终被其吞并。
value.en: After a long rivalry with Kosala it was absorbed into that kingdom.

en: Vatsa, also called Vamsa, as an ancient Indian kingdom in the Ganges plain
Its capital at Kaushambi and its rivalry with Kosala and Magadha
zh: 跋蹉又称瓦姆萨，是恒河平原的古代印度王国
以憍赏弥为都，与憍萨罗及摩揭陀竞争

politics.zh: 跋蹉又称瓦姆萨，是恒河平原的古代印度王国，位于今阿拉哈巴德一带，约公元前6世纪起见于佛教与耆那教文献，以憍赏弥为都，是十六大国之一。它由本地王统统治，与憍萨罗、摩揭陀及阿槃提互动，国王优填王在佛教文献中记载较多；约公元前4世纪被摩揭陀的难陀王朝吞并，其地并入摩揭陀势力范围。
politics.en: Vatsa, also called Vamsa, was an ancient Indian kingdom in the Ganges plain in the area of what is now Prayagraj, recorded from about the sixth century BC in Buddhist and Jain texts, with Kaushambi as its capital, and one of the mahajanapadas. Ruled by a local royal line, it interacted with Kosala, Magadha and Avanti, its king Udayana being well recorded in Buddhist texts; in about the fourth century BC it was absorbed by the Nanda dynasty of Magadha and its lands passed into the Magadhan sphere.

economy.zh: 经济以亚穆纳河与恒河交汇地区的农业、手工业与河运贸易为基础，憍赏弥是商路节点，谷物、棉花与布匹是重要交换物，河流便利运输，市镇与集市经济发达。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming at the confluence of the Yamuna and Ganges, crafts and river trade, with Kaushambi a node on the trade routes, grain, cotton and cloth among the goods exchanged, the rivers easing transport, and town and market economy well developed.

culture.zh: 跋蹉在佛教与耆那教文献中地位重要，憍赏弥是早期佛教中心之一，寺院与佛塔遗址见于考古，梵语与俗语文学记载其宫廷与宗教辩论，雕塑与钱币留下物质遗存。
culture.en: Vatsa holds an important place in Buddhist and Jain texts, Kaushambi being one of the early Buddhist centres, its monasteries and stupas known from archaeology, Sanskrit and Prakrit literature recording its court and religious debates, and its sculpture and coins leaving material remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前6世纪作为十六大国之一的形成、与憍萨罗及摩揭陀的竞争、优填王时期的强盛，以及约公元前4世纪被难陀王朝吞并，这些事件构成印度早期国家竞争的历史。
events.en: Key moments are its formation as one of the mahajanapadas around the sixth century BC, its rivalry with Kosala and Magadha, its strength under King Udayana and its absorption by the Nanda dynasty around the fourth century BC, events that make up the history of early Indian state competition.

value.zh: 约公元前4世纪被难陀王朝吞并。
value.en: It was absorbed by the Nanda dynasty around the fourth century BC.

en: Malla as an ancient Indian republic or territory in the Ganges plain
Its division into two parts and its place among the mahajanapadas of the sixth century BC
zh: 末罗是恒河平原的古代印度共和国或地区
分为两部分，是公元前6世纪十六大国之一

politics.zh: 末罗是恒河平原的古代印度共和国或地区，位于今北方邦东部与比哈尔北部一带，公元前6世纪起见于佛教与耆那教文献，分为两支，分别以拘尸那揭罗与波婆为中心。它由部族议事会治理，与其他共和国及摩揭陀、憍萨罗互动，佛陀在此入灭的传说使其具有宗教意义；后逐步被摩揭陀势力吞并。
politics.en: Malla was an ancient Indian republic or territory in the Ganges plain in what is now eastern Uttar Pradesh and northern Bihar, recorded from the sixth century BC in Buddhist and Jain texts and divided into two branches centred on Kusinara and Pava. Governed by tribal assemblies, it interacted with other republics and with Magadha and Kosala, its association with the Buddha's death giving it religious significance; it was gradually absorbed by Magadhan power.

economy.zh: 经济以恒河平原东部的农业、畜牧与商路贸易为基础，村落与市镇参与区域交换，谷物、布匹与林产品是重要交换物，商道连接摩揭陀与憍萨罗方向。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding in the eastern Ganges plain and on trade along the routes, with villages and towns taking part in regional exchange, grain, cloth and forest products among the goods exchanged, and routes linking the direction of Magadha and Kosala.

culture.zh: 末罗在佛教与耆那教传统中地位重要，拘尸那揭罗是佛教四大圣地之一，佛塔与寺院遗址见于考古，部族共和制度与宗教辩论反映早期印度的政治文化。
culture.en: Malla holds an important place in Buddhist and Jain tradition, Kusinara being one of the four great Buddhist pilgrimage sites, its stupas and monastery remains known from archaeology, and its tribal republican institutions and religious debates reflecting the political culture of early India.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前6世纪作为十六大国之一的形成、两支并立的部族共和制度、与摩揭陀及憍萨罗的互动，以及此后被摩揭陀逐步吞并，这些事件构成印度早期共和国历史的一部分。
events.en: Key moments are its formation as one of the mahajanapadas in the sixth century BC, its two branches with tribal republican institutions, its dealings with Magadha and Kosala and its gradual absorption by Magadhan power, events that form part of the history of the early Indian republics.

value.zh: 分为两支，分以拘尸那揭罗与波婆为中心。
value.en: It was divided into two branches centred on Kusinara and Pava.

value.zh: 拘尸那揭罗是佛教四大圣地之一。
value.en: Kusinara is one of the four great Buddhist pilgrimage sites.
